paite: Ahihleh unaute aw, dan in mi adamsung teng atungah vai ahawm nak chih na thei kei ua hia? Dan thei mite kiang ah ka gen ahi.
heading: Dan Sihsanna Khrist A Hinna Ahi
english: Or don’t you know, brothers The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?

paite: Pasal nei lai numei apasal damsung teng apasal ah dan a hen in a-om ngal a; himahleh asih in bel pasal lam ah dan a kipan khahkhiak in a-om hi.
english: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.

paite: Huchi a apasal damsung a midang akitenpihleh angkawm chih ahi ding a; apasal asih in bel huai dan a kipan khahkhiak in a-om a, huchi in midang nei taleh leng angkawm ahi kei hi.
english: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.

paite: Huchi ahih mah bang in ka unaute aw, Pathian lam a i gahtheihna ding in midang, misi lak a kipan kaihthoh ngeingei na kitenpih theihna ding un, Khrist pumpi pansan in dan lam ah sihsak in na omta uhi.
english: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might bring forth fruit to God.

paite: Sa a i om lai un dan ziak a khelhna utna hong suakte'n, i sahiangte ah sihna khop a gah ding in asem nak hi.
english: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law, worked in our members to bring forth fruit to death.

paite: Tu in bel hon henpa lak ah si khin in, dan a kipan khah in i omta, laigelh lui bang hilou a, Kha a hinna thak a nna i septheihna ding in.
english: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.

paite: Bang i genta dia le? Dan khelhna ahi a hia le? Hilou hial! Himahleh, dan tawn a theih hi keileh khelhna thei lou ding hi ing a; dan in, "Eng ke'n," chi keileh, en chih thei lou ding ka hi.
heading: Dan Leh Khelhna
english: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin, except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting, unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.” Exodus 20:17; Deuteronomy 5:21

paite: Himahleh khelhna in, thupiak ziak in, lemtan lai mu in ka sung ah enna chiteng a-omsak hi. Dan pang lou in khelhna kichi asisa ahi ngal a.
english: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.

paite: Tuma lam in kei dan lou in ka na hing a; himahleh thupiak ahong omtak in khelhna ahong halh a, kei ka sita hi.
english: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.

paite: Huan hinna thuchiam nei thupiak kei a ding in sihna ahong hi chih ka na theita hi.
english: The commandment, which was for life, this I found to be for death;

paite: Khelhna in thupiak ziak in, lemtanna la in ahon khem a, huai tungtawn mah in ahon hihlumta hi.
english: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.

paite: Huchi ahih ziak in dan asiangthou a, thupiak leng asiangthou in, adik a, ahoih ahi.
english: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.

paite: Ahihleh thil hoih kichi kei a ding in sihna ahong hi a hia? Hilou hial! Khelhna tuh kei a ding in sihna ahong hi zawta hi. Huchi in khelhna, khelhna ahi chih alattheihna ding in thil hoih zang in ahon that a; thupiak ziak a khelhna, khelhna pen thupitak ahong hihtheihna ding in.
heading: Mi Omdan Thuah Nih
english: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, by working death to me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceeding sinful.

paite: Dan ahihleh khalam thil ahi chih i thei ngal ua, kei bel sami, khelhna a khotsa ka hi.
english: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.

paite: Keimah thilhih mah leng ka theisiam thei kei; ka thilhih zel pen lah ka hih ut lam ahi ngal kei a, ka thil huat lamtak ka hih zaw nak ngal a.
english: For I don’t know what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.

paite: Ka hih ut louh lam ka hih zel in tuh, dan hoih ahi chih pompih ka suak hi.
english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.

paite: Tu in, huai thilhih pen keimah ahi nawnta kei a, keimah a om khelhna in ahih ahi zaw hi.
english: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

paite: Keimah ah, huai bel, ka taksa ah, thil hoih hih ding lunggulhna zaw keimah ah a-om, himahleh huai thil hoih bangchi sepsuah ding ahia chih ka thei zou kei.
english: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.

paite: Thil hoih hih ka ut pen hih lou in, khelhna hih ka ut louh pen, ka hih zaw kha nak ngal a.
english: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.

paite: Tu in ka hih ut louh lam pen ka hihleh, ahihpa kei ka hi nawnta kei a, ka sung a teng huai khelhna pen ahi zaw hi.
english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

paite: Huchi in thil hoih hih ka ut laitak in kei ah gitlouhna ahong om nak chih hiai dan ka mukhia hi.
english: I find then the law, that, to me, while I desire to do good, evil is present.

paite: Ka lungsim taktak in Pathian dan tung ah ka kipahpih ngal nak a;
english: For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,

paite: himahleh ka sahiangte ah dan tuam a-om chih ka thei, huai in ka lungsim dan adou a, ka sahiangte a khelhna dan om kiang ah sal in ahon pi hi.
english: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.

paite: Genthei hi na lawmlawm ing e! Hiai sihna pumpi a pan kua'n ahia hon suahtaksak ding?
english: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?

paite: Jesu Khrist i Toupa ziak in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen hi. Huchi in keimah tak in zaw ka lungsim in Pathian dan ka sem a, ka taksa in bel gitlouhna dan asem hi.
english: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, the sin’s law.
